name: HTTP
short_description: HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) is the request-response protocol of the web; its methods such as GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE and its numeric status codes form the basis of REST APIs.

evidence.quote: It is the HTTP method, and there are only a handful you'll ever meet in normal work.
Apps and services usually send them over HTTP, which is the same language your browser uses to talk to websites.
